summary: Checked the goal predicates and criteria LH1-C1..LH4-C7 against src/gnd/examples/literature/reading.py, depth.py, assurance_report.py, assertion_admission.py and the four test files at the close commit; the delivered code and tests substantively meet the criteria, all ten close-delta items are true of the code and justified, and the four unread repairs (59fd62f0, 9df661c8, f718b572, 4428a24d) are present in the recorded bytes with their regression tests. Two concerns: the close-results table asserts completion predicates whose cited evidence (006-milestone-close.md and evidence/close-review/) does not exist at this commit, and the delta omits one small recorded departure. What I verified: A1 (retained ceiling is gnd.input_policy.MAX_BYTES = 10 MiB, imported as LIMIT_CEILINGS['retained_bytes'] at reading.py:70 and tested by test_lh1 R9); A2/A3 (README deviation and phase delegated rulings); delta items 4-10 (measured per-file retained bound in _retained_cap reading.py:915-960; scalar_identity handle keying assertion_admission.py:21,296-300; reasons-as-pairs 144-158; model-before-route 500-510; shape kind in the /2 record 527-531; input-time receipt checks reading.py:362-378). The unread-repair code was read especially: the R1-R9/R1-R3/R1-R5/R1-R2 regression tests and their fixes (measured retained bounds, unserializable answers and receipts, saved-receipt validation before any producer call, supersession-source stop fix, non-UTF-8 sources, boolean-vs-number handles, opaque values, scalar rule values) are all present and coherent; the retained-cap arithmetic is measured from actual canonical bytes and covers every retained file including stage records, payloads, receipts and coverage rows.
